mechanics.definition: 在普通赔付结果确定后，对声明作用域中的一个或多个中奖结果应用可观察倍率，并按明确规则合并多个倍率。

conditional_packages.when: progression_driver=cascade_depth且已密封same_depth_multiplier_randomness；同深度仍随机时评分，完全确定时作派生
结构化return_dependency_evidence证明倍率前中奖与倍率状态可在共享事件集中联合观测，全部Cascade深度、持久倍率状态、Wild等直接驱动节点均已进入控制分层，且控制后仍存在剩余依赖
Wild节点通过linked_multiplier_id和专属wild_multiplier_dependency_evidence绑定本倍率，且linked_symbol_domain与同一步事件集可核对
倍率跨结算步骤、旋转或付费入口保留

evidence_signatures: pre-multiplier win, effective multiplier and post-multiplier win are jointly observable or exactly reproducible
each applied multiplier event has a stable event id
all direct multiplier drivers are identified by node id and jointly observable in the same semantic event set
value_symbol_effective_multiplier_binding, when present, proves a bijection between all realized value-symbol assignment instances and applied multiplier events with no additional multiplier source

cascade_depth_multiplier_binding, when present, covers every reachable terminal depth and every actual settlement step from initial step 0 through the final cascade step with a deterministic occurrence, application and effective-value state
multiple multiplier instances follow the declared combination order
exclusions: symbol paytable value is intrinsically larger but no separate multiplier is applied
presentation multiplier that does not change settlement
